name: paracetamol
warning: Contains paracetamol. Overdose or long-term use can cause liver damage — risky for people with liver conditions.

name: ibuprofen
warning: Contains ibuprofen, an NSAID. Can worsen kidney problems, stomach ulcers, and raise blood pressure.

name: aspirin
warning: Contains aspirin. Can increase bleeding risk and irritate the stomach lining.

name: penicillin
warning: Contains a penicillin-based antibiotic. Can cause severe allergic reactions in penicillin-sensitive individuals.

name: dextromethorphan
warning: Cough suppressant. Can interact dangerously with antidepressant medications (serotonin syndrome risk).

name: guaifenesin
warning: Expectorant used to loosen mucus. Generally safe, but avoid with known sensitivity.

name: pseudoephedrine
warning: Decongestant used for flu/cold. Can raise blood pressure and heart rate — risky for hypertension and heart conditions.

name: loperamide
warning: Used for diarrhea (gastro). Should be used cautiously in people with liver conditions.

name: hyoscine
warning: Used for stomach cramps/gastro spasms. Avoid with glaucoma or certain muscle conditions.

name: oral rehydration salts
warning: Used for dehydration from gastro/diarrhea. Use cautiously with kidney conditions due to electrolyte content.

name: cetirizine
warning: Antihistamine for allergies. Dose adjustment may be needed with kidney conditions.

name: loratadine
warning: Antihistamine for allergies. Use cautiously with liver conditions.

name: fexofenadine
warning: Antihistamine for allergies. Generally well-tolerated, avoid with known sensitivity.

name: fluoxetine
warning: SSRI antidepressant for depression. Requires caution with bipolar disorder or seizure conditions.

name: sertraline
warning: SSRI antidepressant for depression/anxiety. Use cautiously with liver conditions.

name: amitriptyline
warning: Tricyclic antidepressant. Can affect heart rhythm — risky for heart conditions and glaucoma.

name: alprazolam
warning: Benzodiazepine for anxiety. Risk of dependency; caution with liver or respiratory conditions.

name: diazepam
warning: Benzodiazepine for anxiety. Caution with liver, respiratory, or muscle conditions.

name: omeprazole
warning: Used for stomach ulcers/acidity. Long-term use linked to bone density loss and kidney issues.

name: ranitidine
warning: Used for ulcers/acidity. Dose adjustment needed with kidney conditions.

name: benzocaine
warning: Topical dental pain relief. Rare risk of a serious blood condition (methemoglobinemia) in sensitive individuals.

name: chlorhexidine
warning: Antiseptic mouthwash for dental care. Avoid with known sensitivity.

name: sulfa drugs
warning: Contains a sulfonamide (sulfa) compound. Can trigger severe allergic reactions in sulfa-sensitive individuals.

name: insulin
warning: Insulin dosage must be carefully managed — incorrect use can cause dangerously low blood sugar.
